title: isoglossa ovata
intro: Isoglossa ovata, commonly known as the green coral vine, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of the Pacific Islands. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit bacterial growth, and exhibit antioxidant activity. Bioactive constituents of Isoglossa ovata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
